default.bib.landing.title: Bibs & Donation
default.bib.landing.intro: defcon.run remains a FREE daily event — if you'd like to financially support, we would appreciate it.
default.bib.donate.title: Just donate
default.bib.donate.subhead: Support goes directly to defcon.run 34. Thank you!
default.bib.checkout.sliderHelper: Slide or type any amount from ${min} up to ${max}.
default.bib.checkout.providerNote: Venmo contributions are confirmed by an organizer — your contribution appears once approved.
default.bib.checkout.error: Could not start checkout ({detail}) — try again.
default.bib.contribution.donateBody: This long-running event would value any financial support you'd like to give. Every year we try to provide an accessible and memorable event for all.
default.bib.contribution.sponsorBody: Contributing to the event helps cover the cost of bibs and other swag. We appreciate your support.
default.bib.contribution.limitNote: That's plenty of cash for now — 30 rains max per event! 💸
default.bib.contribution.optBurn: 🔥 Fuck that bib. I don't want one.
default.bib.contribution.hintInPerson: Pay $20 cash/card at defcon.run 34 and we'll print your name on a custom bib.
default.bib.contribution.hintBurn: You torched it. No name, no bib — pick another option to bring it back.
default.bib.cashConfirm.title: One more step to lock it in 💵
default.bib.cashConfirm.instruction: Send your bib code above to Agent X on Signal to confirm your in-person payment — we'll print your bib once it's confirmed.
default.bib.status.paymentSuccess: Payment received — thanks for supporting defcon.run 34! Reconciliation may take a moment.
default.bib.status.donationSuccess: Donation received — thanks for backing defcon.run 34! 🙏 Reconciliation may take a moment.
default.bib.status.paymentCancel: Checkout cancelled. No charge was made — you can try again below.
default.bib.status.burningBibAlt: Your bib is a dumpster fire.
default.bib.instructions.requiredCommentHint: This BIB-XXXX code must be in the payment note so we can match your sponsorship to your bib.
default.bib.instructions.reconcileNoteBefore: After you send the payment, come back here — reconciliation is automatic and usually finishes within a few minutes. Payments without
default.bib.instructions.reconcileNoteAfter: in the note are flagged for manual review.
default.bib.instructions.venmoSubhead: DEF CON 34 — send the amount below with your runner code in the note.
default.bib.instructions.cashappSubhead: DEF CON 34 — send the amount below and paste your runner code as the note before you tap send.
default.bib.bibform.lockedHint: Name locked for print — contact organizers to change it.
default.bib.txn.reconcileNote: Venmo & Cash App contributions appear here once an organizer confirms them.
default.bib.admin.rejectConfirm: Reject this bib? This deletes the bib and pending payments and resets the runner's name-change quota. Donations are kept.
default.bib.bibform.tooLongWarn: Heads up — names over {max} characters may print small on the bib. Trim to {max} or fewer for a bold, readable bib.
default.bib.instructions.scanCaption: On a computer? Scan with your phone to open {provider} with the amount and runner code prefilled.
default.bib.accessDenied.title: Access Denied
default.bib.accessDenied.body: You don't have access to the defcon.run 34 bib registration app. This service requires the bib service claim on your defcon.run account.
default.bib.accessDenied.contact: Contact an administrator to request access.
